metadata.title: Analysis of the Effects of World Bank Macroeconomic and Management Indicators on Sustainable Education Quality on PISA Scores Using the SHAP Explainable Artificial Intelligence Method

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study constructs country-level datasets and does not analyze student-level ILSA microdata, making plausible values handling not applicable.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not use sampling weights, treating the data as an aggregate country/region-level dataset.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit, as it focuses on country-level data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions using bootstrap confidence intervals for internal validation but does not validate findings on external datasets or different countries.
